subject.title: fix(ci): honor Kova performance report contracts

question: Should the maintainer-owned release-performance CI contract fix land after exact-head checks pass?
rationale: The source and dependency review support the patch, but the protected `maintainer` label and release-performance workflow surface make landing an explicit maintainer action rather than an automated cleanup decision.

options.title: Merge after exact-head checks
options.body: Land the PR once current-base required checks are green because the patch matches pinned Kova's report and include-filter contracts.

options.title: Hold for fresh release-lane proof
options.body: Ask for an additional OpenClaw Performance run if maintainers want workflow-level proof beyond the PR's reported Testbox and failed-run evidence.

options.title: Move the contract upstream
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want Kova itself to change its CLI/report contract instead of adapting OpenClaw's trusted adapter.

recommendation.title: Merge after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Land the PR once current-base required checks are green because the patch matches pinned Kova's report and include-filter contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assignee and has recent history on the affected performance workflow and adjacent release-performance hardening.
